name: Nan Poisons Consumer
essence: A blank shipping-rate input becomes NaN and selects an absent rate label.

examples.summary: A blank shipping-rate input becomes NaN and selects an absent rate label.
examples.mechanism: An unvalidated parse mutates the monetary rate to NaN; rounding preserves NaN, so indexing yields undefined and the next method call throws.
examples.observed_output: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')
examples.expected_behavior: Reject the blank rate before updating the quote or indexing the rate table.

ingredients.suggests: The mutable shipping rate is parsed as a floating-point value and rounded into a pricing tier.
A blank input is parsed and immediately used as a table index without a finite-number check.

examples.summary: Unvalidated floating-point input sets the rate to NaN, and rounding that rate for a table index raises ValueError..
examples.mechanism: Unvalidated floating-point input sets the rate to NaN, and rounding that rate for a table index raises ValueError.
examples.observed_output: ValueError: cannot convert float NaN to integer
examples.expected_behavior: Reject non-finite rates before looking up a shipping tier.

ingredients.suggests: The mutable shipping rate is a floating-point value rounded into a pricing tier.
An unvalidated non-finite numeric string reaches a consumer that requires an integer index.

examples.summary: An unchecked non-finite rate selects a missing pricing callback and panics.
examples.mechanism: An unchecked non-finite rate selects a missing pricing callback and panics.
examples.observed_output: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
examples.expected_behavior: Reject non-finite rates before choosing a pricing tier.

ingredients.suggests: The mutable floating-point shipping rate is rounded into a pricing tier.
The parsed rate is used without a finite-number check.

examples.summary: NaN never matches a table key and the consumer unwraps a missing tier.
examples.mechanism: The monetary rate is a mutable floating-point value rounded into a pricing tier. Blank input is accepted as NaN and used to look up a tier without checking finiteness.
examples.expected_behavior: Blank rates are rejected before tier lookup.
